text:
Clean and Fast,   I can speak thai quite well  & also with the help of google translate I was able to make myself be understood although I did not require any complicated procedure.

I just needed a simple teeth clean: the price was fair, establishment clean and staff polite and  profesional.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมวันใส
text: The male doctor named Sanguan has a bad attitude and is unhelpful with questions. My braces kept coming loose in the beginning, even though I was careful about my diet. My friends who had braces done here experienced the same thing. The doctor said he used high-quality glue – seriously? Another friend who went to a different clinic never had any problems. Honestly, if the doctor were more polite, I could tolerate it, but he was rude every time I saw him. It was so uncomfortable; I only lasted half a year before changing doctors. If you're considering going there and don't mind listening to this doctor complain and berate patients, then go ahead.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมวันใส
text: The doctor is gentle and kind, and the clinic is clean and spacious.
